note: Both sets are accurate and faithful on the shared claims, with quotes correctly supporting the stated goals, configuration, filter type, and variable definitions. Set A adds three further supported claims that Set B omits: the full-span rotor-collective blade-pitch controller operating above rated wind speed in power-production operation, the generator-torque controller operating below rated wind speed in power-production operation, and the two power-production control systems of the NREL 5-MW baseline turbine. Set A's extras are somewhat redundant with its other claims but are not wrong, so its coverage of the page is more complete while neither set invents facts.
